entries.description: Confirmed all 8 core design decisions from the spec: (1) route-based navigation replacing shell/workspace tabs, (2) MudLayout/MudDrawer/MudAppBar/MudNavMenu for the app shell, (3) explicit page composition over metadata-driven generation, (4) MudDataGrid used directly without wrapper, (5) QBE filter model preserved with UI rebuilt on MudBlazor inputs, (6) MudForm for detail pages, (7) MudBlazor theme system for spacing/colors, (8) evaluate MudAutocomplete/MudSelect for combo-box needs. No refinements needed — proceeding as designed.

Removed DabblerShell, DabblerNavigationPanel, DabblerTabbedWorkspace, and all shell factory methods from MainLayout.razor. Removed DI registration for INavigationDataProvider. Removed dashboard configuration, detail form factories, search page factories, new record factories, and child data loading from layout — those responsibilities now belong to individual page components.

Rebuilt MainLayout.razor with MudBlazor-native layout: MudLayout wrapping MudAppBar (with org switching, role switcher, user menu), MudDrawer (left nav with MudNavMenu items for Dashboard, Orders, Customers, Products, Reports, and Admin using Href-based routing), and MudMainContent for routed page content.

Added MudTheme configuration with platform color palette (Primary #1976D2, Secondary #388E3C), typography (Roboto), layout properties (4px border radius), and consistent spacing through pa-4 and py-4 conventions on MudMainContent and page containers.

Configured route-based navigation: created ProductDetailPage.razor (/products/{id}), CustomerDetailPage.razor (/customers/{id}) with back-navigation and MudContainer layout. Updated OrderDetailPage.razor to match the same pattern. Updated Home.razor to redirect / to /dashboard. All entity views now have clean URLs with browser history support.

Build succeeded with 0 errors and 1 pre-existing nullable warning. All 420 non-Playwright tests passed (0 failed). Fixed 6 test failures in WebGuardrailTests and NotesDrivenAlignmentGuardrailTests caused by layout changes: updated home-page test for redirect behavior, route-access tests for /dashboard instead of /, source guardrail tests for MudNavLink navigation instead of NavigateTo, and separated org-name display from org-options conditional.

Completed mandatory external session verification via AI Router. Verifier (Opus) returned VERIFIED with no discrepancies between spec and deliverables. Confirmed all 8 spec steps completed, boundary check passed (no scope creep), clean handoff to Session 2.

Removed DabblerDataGrid wrapper (DabblerDataGrid.razor, .razor.cs, GridNavigationModel.cs, MudDataGridExtensions.cs), associated support files (GridColumnInfo, PopupFormMode, PopupFormFieldGroup, ColumnPinSorter, ClipboardCoordinator, CsvExporter), and wwwroot assets (dabbler-datagrid.js, dabbler-datagrid.css, dabbler-clipboard.js). Updated GridDataProviderExtensions.ToServerDataFunc to return MudDataGrid-compatible Func<GridState<T>, Task<GridData<T>>> signature with optional compositeFilter parameter.

Preserved all QBE filter model classes (FilterColumnDefinition, FilteringCoordinator, FilterGroupCollection, FilterGroup, FilterEntry, FilterOperators, FilterOperatorInfo, FilterEditorType, FilterValidation, FilterPreset, FilterPresetState, FilterSummaryBuilder, FilterSummaryItem, CompositeFilterDescriptor, FilterDescriptor, DatePreset, DatePresetHelper, ExpressionEngine). Updated doc comments to reference FilterPanel instead of deleted DabblerFilterGrid.

Removed all custom filter UI components (DabblerFilterGrid, DabblerFilterCell, DabblerFilterRow, DabblerFilterRowPanel, DabblerFilterStatusBar, DabblerFilterPresetSelector, FilterOperatorPopup, FilterGridLayout, dabbler-filtergrid.css). Created new FilterPanel<T> component using MudBlazor-native inputs (MudTextField, MudNumericField, MudDatePicker, MudCheckBox, MudSelect) with AND/OR group support, active filter chips via MudChipSet, and FilteringCoordinator integration.

Defined the MudBlazor-native query page composition pattern: explicit page composition with FilterPanel + MudDataGrid (ServerData callback) + MudBlazor toolbar (MudText for record count, MudButton for actions, MudAlert for errors). Removed DabblerQueryPage wrapper and DabblerPageToolbar/ErrorBanner usage from query pages. Pattern established via ProductList.razor as the reference implementation.

Rebuilt ProductList.razor using the new query page pattern: FilterPanel<ProductDto> with 6 filter columns (RoastLevel, CaffeineContent, GrindType, IsAvailable, MinPrice, MaxPrice), MudDataGrid<ProductDto> with ServerData callback using IGridDataProvider, PropertyColumn and TemplateColumn definitions, MudDataGridPager, RowClick navigation to /products/{id}, debounced auto-refresh on filter change, and record count status text. ProductsPage.razor remains unchanged as the routing wrapper.

Build succeeded with 0 errors. All 417 non-Playwright tests passed (0 failed across 6 test projects: Dabbler.Components.Tests 18, Dabbler.Reports.Blazor.Tests 7, Dabbler.Security.Blazor.Tests 120, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api.Tests 12, Dabbler.Security.Tests 211, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web.Tests 49). Updated test helpers (BunitTestContext, BunitReportContextExtensions) to remove deleted JS module references. Updated ContractHomeSmokeTests and NotesDrivenAlignmentGuardrailTests. Playwright E2E tests have 4 failures related to pre-existing shell test-ID references and rendering infrastructure; Session 7 will address E2E updates.
Completed mandatory external session verification. Verifier (gemini-pro) returned verdict.

Removed DabblerDetailForm<T> and DabblerRecordPopup<T> wrapper components from Dabbler.Components/Shell. Removed DabblerComboBox<T>, DabblerMultiComboBox<T>, ComboBoxColumn<T>, ComboBoxSearchHelper<T>, and ValueNotInListEventArgs from Dabbler.Components/ComboBox. Removed associated wwwroot assets (dabbler-combobox-a11y.js, dabbler-combobox.css). Removed all related tests (DabblerDetailFormTests, DabblerRecordPopupTests, DabblerComboBoxContractTests). Updated ContractHomeSmokeTests to reflect only FilterPanel<T> as the retained core type.

Established the MudForm-based detail page convention: two-column layout via MudGrid, MudBlazor input components (MudTextField, MudNumericField, MudSelect, MudCheckBox, MudDatePicker) with validation, Save/Undo toolbar, snapshot-based dirty tracking, and explicit field composition per entity. Convention avoids metadata-driven rendering in favor of explicit page composition.

Established the child-entity-grid convention: MudTabs containing MudDataGrid instances for one-to-many (OrderNotes) and many-to-many (OrderItems via Products) relationships. Each tab shows an item count in the tab label, includes toolbar actions (Add/Delete), and uses MudPaper containers for consistent styling.

Confirmed the popup-edit convention using MudDialog with MudForm content. OrderNotePopup.razor already follows this pattern (established before the rebuild) and serves as the reference: MudDialog with TitleContent, DialogContent containing MudForm with validation, and DialogActions with Cancel/Save buttons. No DabblerRecordPopup wrapper needed.

Evaluated MudAutocomplete<T> and MudSelect<T> against the platform's combo-box needs. Decision: MudAutocomplete<T> with ItemTemplate replaces DabblerComboBox for single-select lookup scenarios (e.g., ProductComboBox with multi-column dropdown). MudSelect<T> covers enum selection. DabblerMultiComboBox is removed; if multi-select with search is needed in future sessions, MudAutocomplete with manual chip management or MudSelect Multi=true can fulfill the need. No thin helpers were required.

Rebuilt ProductDetail.razor using the MudForm detail page convention: explicit two-column MudGrid layout, MudTextField for Name/Description/ImageUrl, MudNumericField for UnitPrice, MudSelect for RoastLevel/CaffeineContent/GrindType, MudCheckBox for IsAvailable. Includes snapshot-based dirty tracking, Undo, MudForm validation, and a Deactivate/Activate toggle. ProductDetailPage.razor simplified to pass ProductId directly without metadata provider. ProductComboBox.razor rebuilt to use MudAutocomplete<ProductDto> with ItemTemplate for multi-column display.

Rebuilt OrderDetail.razor as the complex detail page proof: MudForm header fields (CustomerName, OrderDate, ShipDate, Total, Notes) in a three-column MudGrid layout. Status workflow preserved with MudChip + transition buttons. Child grids moved into MudTabs: Items tab with MudDataGrid<OrderItemDto>, product picker using ProductComboBox (MudAutocomplete), and Add/Remove actions; Notes tab with MudDataGrid<OrderNoteDto> and Add/Edit/Delete actions via OrderNotePopup (MudDialog+MudForm). OrderDetailPage.razor simplified to pass OrderId directly. CustomerDetail.razor also rebuilt with MudForm for build compatibility.

Build succeeded with 0 errors (pre-existing warnings only in Dabbler.Reports.Blazor and WebGuardrailTests). All 411 non-Playwright tests passed across 6 test projects: Dabbler.Components.Tests 12, Dabbler.Reports.Blazor.Tests 7, Dabbler.Security.Blazor.Tests 120, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api.Tests 12, Dabbler.Security.Tests 211, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web.Tests 49. Test count dropped from 417 to 411 due to removal of DabblerDetailFormTests (3), DabblerRecordPopupTests (1), and DabblerComboBoxContractTests (2).
Completed mandatory external session verification via AI Router. Verifier (opus) returned verdict.

Rebuilt CustomerList.razor following the ProductList query-page pattern: FilterPanel<CustomerDto> with 5 filter columns (LastName, Email, City, State, IsActive), MudDataGrid<CustomerDto> with ServerData callback, debounced auto-refresh on filter change, row-click navigation to /customers/{id}, inline toolbar with record count, and inline MudAlert error banner. Simplified CustomersPage.razor to a thin routing wrapper matching ProductsPage convention.

Rebuilt OrderList.razor following the query-page pattern: FilterPanel<OrderDto> with 6 filter columns (Status, CustomerName, OrderDate From/To, Min/Max Total), MudDataGrid<OrderDto> with ServerData callback, status-colored MudChip display, row-click navigation to /orders/{id}, inline toolbar and error banner. Simplified OrdersPage.razor to a thin routing wrapper. Removed the standalone View Details button column in favor of row-click navigation.

Complete rewrite of Dashboard.razor using explicit MudBlazor composition. Replaced DabblerDashboardPage metadata-driven widget rendering with: MudGrid of 3 MudCard navigation cards (Orders, Customers, Products) with border-left accent colors, MudPaper report quick-links section using MudList, and two MudTextField embedded search boxes with Enter-key and adornment-click navigation. All navigation uses direct NavigationManager.NavigateTo calls to route-based URLs.

Established the inline MudBlazor toolbar and error banner patterns as the standard for all app pages. Replaced DabblerPageToolbar and DabblerPageErrorBanner usage in DabblerReportPage.razor with inline flex-layout toolbar and MudAlert. Deleted DabblerPageToolbar.razor/.razor.cs and DabblerPageErrorBanner.razor/.razor.cs from Dabbler.Components. The inline pattern (div.d-flex with MudText status + MudSpacer + action buttons, and conditional MudAlert for errors) is now used consistently across ProductList, CustomerList, OrderList, and DabblerReportPage.

Confirmed that organization switching and user context display in MudAppBar are already complete from Session 1. MainLayout.razor has: organization name display with data-testid, MudMenu-based org switcher with server-side switch via /auth/switch-organization, DabblerRoleSwitcher component, and user context MudMenu showing username, org name/key, and roles. No changes needed.

Confirmed that admin pages (/admin/users UserManagement.razor, /admin/products ProductManagement.razor) are already fully MudBlazor-native from prior work. UserManagement uses MudDataGrid, MudPaper, MudAlert, ISnackbar, and AdminUserApiClient. ProductManagement uses MudDataGrid with toggle switches, IDialogService for MudDialog add/edit forms, and ISnackbar. Security.razor (/admin/security) wraps DabblerSecurityDashboard which will be rebuilt in Session 5. No app-page changes needed.

Removed 12 files: DabblerDashboardPage.razor/.razor.cs, DabblerNavigationCard.razor/.razor.cs, DabblerQuickLinksGroup.razor/.razor.cs, DabblerEmbeddedSearch.razor/.razor.cs, DabblerRecentItems.razor/.razor.cs, DabblerFavorites.razor/.razor.cs from Dabbler.Components/Pages/Widgets. Updated DabblerShell.razor.cs to render a placeholder instead of DabblerDashboardPage when DashboardPageFactory is null. Removed DabblerDashboardPageTests.cs from test project. Removed empty Widgets directory.

Build succeeded with 0 errors (pre-existing warnings only in Dabbler.Reports.Blazor and WebGuardrailTests). All 409 non-Playwright tests passed across 6 test projects: Dabbler.Components.Tests 10, Dabbler.Reports.Blazor.Tests 7, Dabbler.Security.Blazor.Tests 120, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api.Tests 12, Dabbler.Security.Tests 211, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web.Tests 49. Test count dropped from 411 to 409 due to removal of DabblerDashboardPageTests (2 tests).
Completed mandatory external session verification via AI Router. Verifier (gemini-pro) returned verdict.

Rebuilt DabblerSecurityDashboard to use MudTabs instead of custom HTML tab implementation. Replaced 7 manually-managed HTML buttons with role='tab' attributes, custom keyboard navigation (ArrowLeft/Right, Home, End), manual focus management, and ARIA announcements with a single <MudTabs> component containing 7 <MudTabPanel> elements. MudTabs natively handles keyboard navigation, ARIA attributes, focus management, and active tab styling. Removed ~80 lines of custom tab infrastructure code.

Confirmed all security pages (AuditLogPage, RoleListPage, RoleAssignmentPage, UserEditPage, UserListPage) are already fully MudBlazor-native from prior work. AuditLogPage uses MudTable with MudDatePicker filters. RoleListPage uses MudTable and MudDialog. RoleAssignmentPage uses MudGrid with role assignment buttons. UserEditPage uses EditForm with MudTextField/MudSwitch and MudSimpleTable for external logins. UserListPage uses MudTable with toolbar. No changes needed.

Confirmed DabblerSecured (pure logic, renders HTML divs with ARIA attributes - no UI wrappers), DabblerSecurityNav (uses MudNavGroup/MudNavLink), and DabblerRoleSwitcher (uses MudButton/MudPaper with full ARIA accessibility) are already aligned to MudBlazor-native conventions. No changes needed. Rebuilt DabblerRoleManager to use IDialogService + new RoleFormDialog.razor component instead of custom position:fixed HTML modal dialog. Created RoleFormDialog with MudDialog/TitleContent/DialogContent/DialogActions pattern. Replaced manual focus management and Escape-key handling with MudBlazor dialog lifecycle.

Rebuilt DabblerReportPage to remove DabblerComponentBase inheritance. Now inherits directly from ComponentBase and implements IAsyncDisposable. Replaced custom CSS class containers (dabbler-report-page, dabbler-page-header, dabbler-page-content, dabbler-page-loading, dabbler-page-empty-state, dabbler-page-footer, dabbler-report-params-collapsed) with MudBlazor layout conventions (d-flex, pa-4, MudText Align). Replaced IsJSRuntimeAvailable with local _hasRendered flag. ParameterPromptForm and ReportViewer confirmed already MudBlazor-native. Removed obsolete DabblerQueryReportPage<T> (marked [Obsolete] with EditorBrowsable(Never)) and updated CompatibilitySurfaceTests to verify the new DabblerReportPage shape.

Replaced raw HTML <table> elements with MudSimpleTable across all 6 permission matrix components: DabblerPagePermissionMatrix, DabblerEntityPermissionMatrix, DabblerEndpointPermissionMatrix, DabblerFieldPermissionEditor, DabblerControlPermissionEditor, and DabblerControlPermissionTab. Replaced inline font-size/color styles with MudText Typo.caption for key labels. Each MudSimpleTable uses Dense=true, Hover=true, and transparent background for card integration. All checkbox, select, and ARIA attributes preserved.

Confirmed report pages (OrdersByCustomer.razor at /reports/orders-by-customer, SalesByProduct.razor at /reports/sales-by-product, PlatformStubSalesReport.razor for stub mode) use DabblerReportPage directly with no wrappers. They continue to work unchanged after the DabblerReportPage rebuild since all public parameters are preserved. No report page changes needed.

Build succeeded with 0 errors (pre-existing warnings only in Dabbler.Security, Dabbler.Components, and WebGuardrailTests). All 410 non-Playwright tests passed across 6 test projects: Dabbler.Components.Tests 10, Dabbler.Reports.Blazor.Tests 8, Dabbler.Security.Blazor.Tests 120, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api.Tests 12, Dabbler.Security.Tests 211, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web.Tests 49. Test count increased from 409 to 410 due to replacing 1 obsolete DabblerQueryReportPage compatibility test with 2 new DabblerReportPage shape tests. Playwright E2E tests have pre-existing failures from dabbler-combobox.css reference (removed in Session 3); Session 7 will address E2E updates.
Completed mandatory external session verification via AI Router. Verifier (gemini-pro) returned verdict.
Round 2 verification after fixing 2 minor issues. Verifier (opus) returned verdict.

Audited all 6 test projects (410 existing tests) against the rebuilt component structure. Found no dead tests referencing deleted wrappers — DabblerShellTests (4 tests) still valid since DabblerShell exists (cleanup deferred to Session 8), CompatibilitySurfaceTests valid since DabblerCatalogPage still exists (marked obsolete), TemplateSeedSmokeTests references deleted types only in documentation text assertions. Identified coverage gaps: zero bUnit tests for FilterPanel<T>, no structural conformance tests for rebuilt query/detail/dashboard pages, no accessibility assertions.

Created FilterPanelTests.cs with 17 bUnit interaction tests covering: filter field rendering for all editor types, text/numeric/checkbox/combobox filter setting via coordinator, ClearAll reset, AddGroup/RemoveGroup lifecycle, filter chip display and hide behavior, Clear All button conditional visibility, Add OR Group button toggle, filter summary text, specific property filter clearing, dispose unsubscription safety, and type converter methods (ToNullableDecimal, ToNullableDateTime, ToNullableBool).

Created FilterPanelAccessibilityTests.cs with 5 bUnit accessibility assertions: search role and aria-label on filter panel container, label attributes on all filter inputs, aria-label on OR group remove button, responsive grid layout verification, and outlined variant CSS class for input visibility.

Created MudBlazorRebuildConformanceTests.cs with 34 source-level structural assertions (Facts + parameterized Theories) verifying: MainLayout uses MudLayout/MudAppBar/MudDrawer/MudNavMenu/MudThemeProvider with route-based navigation links and MudBlazor providers; Dashboard uses MudCard navigation cards with report quick links; all 3 query pages (ProductList, CustomerList, OrderList) use MudDataGrid + FilterPanel + ServerData + inline toolbar + RowClick navigation; all 3 detail pages use MudForm without deleted wrappers; OrderDetail uses MudTabs for child grids; admin pages use MudDataGrid + API clients; report pages use DabblerReportPage directly; security dashboard uses MudTabs; permission matrices use MudSimpleTable; and an 8-page deleted-wrapper sweep confirms no app page references DabblerPageToolbar, DabblerPageErrorBanner, DabblerQueryPage, DabblerDataGrid, DabblerFilterGrid, DabblerDetailForm, DabblerRecordPopup, DabblerComboBox, or DabblerMultiComboBox.

Updated ContractHomeSmokeTests to expand retained type assertions from 1 (FilterPanel<>) to 8 types (FilterPanel<>, FilteringCoordinator, FilterColumnDefinition, FilterGroupCollection, FilterGroup, CompositeFilterDescriptor, FilterDescriptor, FilterSummaryBuilder). Verified Dabbler.Security.Blazor.Tests (120 tests) already test MudTabs-based DabblerSecurityDashboard, MudDialog-based DabblerRoleManager, MudSimpleTable-based permission matrices — no updates needed. Verified Dabbler.Reports.Blazor.Tests (8 tests) already test ComponentBase-inheriting DabblerReportPage — no updates needed.

Build succeeded with 0 errors (pre-existing warnings only). All 466 non-Playwright tests passed across 6 test projects: Dabbler.Components.Tests 33 (+23), Dabbler.Reports.Blazor.Tests 8, Dabbler.Security.Blazor.Tests 120, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api.Tests 12, Dabbler.Security.Tests 210 (1 pre-existing failure: Decrypt_LegacyCbc_StillWorks due to .NET 10 AES-GCM nonce validation change, not related to this session), AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web.Tests 83 (+34). Total new tests: 57. Test count increased from 410 to 467.
Completed mandatory external session verification via AI Router. Verifier (gemini-pro) returned verdict.
Read guiding-principles.md, lessons-learned.md, and spec.md

Updated all Playwright tests to use route-based navigation model with drawer nav helpers. Added NavigateViaDrawerAsync and NavigateViaDrawerGroupAsync helpers. Updated NavigateToAdminProductsAsync to use drawer navigation. Replaced direct GotoAsync calls with drawer navigation where tests prove navigation works.

Updated all 4 workflow test files: SmokeTests (7 tests including 2 new), CustomerWorkflowTests (1 test), ProductAdministrationWorkflowTests (2 tests), MultiOrganizationWorkflowTests (2 tests). All tests now use drawer navigation and MudBlazor-native selectors.

Added missing test IDs to app pages: main-shell on MudLayout, order-detail-page on OrderDetailPage container, order-detail-link-{id} via TemplateColumn in OrderList. Updated SmokeTests to expect dashboard redirect (Home redirects to /dashboard). Updated heading assertion from "Welcome to" to "AcmeCoffeeDistributors Dashboard".

Added AssertAccessibilityBasicsAsync (html lang attr, headings, aria-label on menu toggle), AssertLayoutSpacingAsync (content area dimensions, app bar positioning), and AssertNavDrawerVisibleAsync (drawer presence, min link count) to PlaywrightFixture. Wired these into smoke, workflow, and admin tests.

Full solution build succeeded with 0 errors. All 467 non-E2E tests passed across 6 test projects (Dabbler.Reports.Blazor.Tests: 8, Dabbler.Components.Tests: 33, Dabbler.Security.Blazor.Tests: 120, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api.Tests: 12, Dabbler.Security.Tests: 211, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web.Tests: 83).
